title: Unconditional Code • Michael Feathers • GOTO 2018
summary: Michael Feathers' GOTO Chicago 2018 talk on reducing error checks and conditional logic in code. He offers a framework for handling errors and decisions at the level of code and architecture.
why: HN recommends it for the idea of giving data instead of asking for it, and ties it to zero values and exception-free design.

quote.text: giving data instead of asking for data avoids error conditions
